rule: Lower-body days start with curl-up, side plank, bird dog (McGill big 3)
summary: Warm-ups in general show a likely, not certain, injury reduction in RCTs; the McGill big 3 specifically is a practitioner choice for back history. Cheap; keep.

sources.note: Fradkin 2006 SR of RCTs: 3 of 5 trials show fewer injuries with warm-up; weight of evidence favours it
